title: Tinh gọn modal xem bàn 3D và xác thực AR mặt sàn
rootCause: The reachable global preview still exposes an unrelated 2D camera fallback. Its model-viewer integration also uses the unsupported model-scale attribute and enables the external AR action from URL/HTTPS checks without consulting model-viewer's canActivateAR capability. The smallest correct fix removes the fallback, uses the supported scale attribute, explicitly targets floor placement, and gates AR after the model viewer reports device support.

completed: read relevant ponytail, frontend-design, react performance, UI/UX, redesign, WCAG, and web guideline skills
traced upload route and custom model builder through catalog hook, preview launcher, model-viewer modal, action bar, and tests
confirmed the global preview has no GraphQL persistence mutation
confirmed model-viewer supports floor AR placement, canActivateAR, ar-status, fixed AR scale, and WebXR environment lighting
removed the 2D camera action and camera-overlay caller from the global modal
replaced unsupported model-scale with scale and configured floor placement plus xr-environment
gated the AR action with model-viewer canActivateAR after model load
updated direct component and mobile smoke expectations
notRun: Targeted Vitest, Playwright, conflict check, and build could not run because the available runtime cannot resolve github.com to obtain a checkout and no workflow run was created for the direct main-branch commits.
Physical Android/iOS floor detection remains pending because it requires an AR-capable device, HTTPS, camera permission, and a real surface.
